verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's core product surface is API-first: payments, payouts, mandates and recurring payments, account data, verification and webhooks are all documented as APIs, with SDKs and an MCP server on top. However, several things are documented only in the Console UI with no API equivalent in evidence: monitoring and reports, balance reports, sweeping configuration, inviting users and issuing refunds, retrieving client credentials, and setting the webhook URI per app. The probe also found no public OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: API parity for Console functions (reporting, balance reports, sweeping config, team/user management, webhook URI configuration, credential management), a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of full parity.
